title: DC Voltage Controller
text: Discrete-time DC voltage PI control with feedforward zero cancellation and integral anti-windup, 3 inputs, 1 output; {Proportional gain}, {Integral gain}, {Anti-windup gain}, {Control action upper limit} sets the upper limit for the control signal, control, {Control action lower limit} sets the lower limit for the control signal, control, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the block sample time, {Discretization sample time} sets the sample time for discretization, {Time constant voltage filter} sets the dC voltage filter time constant, τ, {Enable zero cancellation} sets the feedforward zero cancellation and {Filter DC voltage} sets the dC voltage filter. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Proportional gain
params.values: Proportional gain, K p 0.1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Integral gain
params.values: Integral gain, K i 50 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Anti-windup gain
params.values: Anti-windup gain, K aw 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Control action upper limit
params.values: Upper limit for the control signal, control max 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Control action lower limit
params.values: Lower limit for the control signal, control min 0 (default) | non-negative scalar

params.name: Discretization sample time
params.values: Sample time for discretization 0.001 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Time constant voltage filter
params.values: DC voltage filter time constant, τ 0.001 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Filter DC voltage
params.values: DC voltage filter option on (default) | off
